deploybot: :rocket: terraform apply started — workspace `prod-dc4` — environment: dc4-production-gpupool
deploybot: commit: `release/v1.7.9+hotfix.3` tag pinned, plan id `plan-8c3f`
deploybot: summary: 7 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy. ETA ~7m.

marta: holding — we have an ongoing rolling restart in dc4 control-plane, can we stall the apply for 15m? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
aj: +1 to hold. This change resizes a GPU pool; prefer to do canary then rollforward.
kevin: what exactly is changing? can we scope to only patch instance count?
deploybot: plan excerpt:
```
  # module/gpupool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu_pool will be created
  + resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_pool" {
      + desired_capacity = 10
      + max_size = 20
      + min_size = 1
    }
  # module/gpupool.aws_launch_template.template will be updated
  ~ resource "aws_launch_template" "template" {
      ~ instance_type = "p4d.24xlarge" -> "p4d.12xlarge"
    }
```

marta: thanks — since instance_type changes are risky during control-plane ops, please pause.
ryan: if we pause, can deploybot keep plan saved so we can resume without replan?
deploybot: yes — plan `plan-8c3f` saved in s3://redwood-terraform/plans/prod-dc4/plan-8c3f.tfplan
kevin: suggestion: pin `instance_type` in the module and only apply ASG capacity change now. we can roll the instance_type in a separate maintenance window.
aj: agreed. can we patch apply by excluding the launch_template resource?
deploybot: accepted hold. cancelling apply run now. rollback/cleanup started.
deploybot: cancelled apply — no resources changed. plan preserved. tag: `release/v1.7.9+hotfix.3` remains pinned.
oncall-bot: reminder set for 15 minutes: resume check-in at <@marta>.
marta: will re-evaluate in 15m and post next steps. :white_check_mark:
